card.summary: Up to 300 GB per transfer, free, no sign-up, 100 files per transfer. There is no total-storage account at all. It is a per-transfer envelope.

free_tier.stated: Up to 300 GB per transfer, free, no sign-up, 100 files per transfer. There is no total-storage account at all. It is a per-transfer envelope.

retention.stated: 300 GB per transfer, 100 files per transfer, retention selectable 3 to 100 days then auto-delete

egress.terms: No monthly transfer caps stated: 'no sign-up, no monthly transfer caps'. No egress price.

record.tooling: Web only; no documented API, no rclone backend.
record.chaining: 300 GB x unlimited transfers, but retention is 3-100 days, so accumulation requires a re-upload loop. Useful as a transit leg, not a store.
record.limits_note: 300 GB per transfer, 100 files per transfer, retention selectable 3 to 100 days then auto-delete. Every upload is security-scanned before publish, so flagged content never appears.
record.reliability_note: Retention max 100 days plus a mandatory malware scan on every file makes this a transfer service; a large binary dataset may be held for scanning before the link works.

evidence.proved: 'up to 300GB ... up to 100 files per transfer, kept up to 100 days'; 'Pick a retention window from 3 to 100 days'

record.notes: Up to 300 GB per transfer, free, no sign-up, 100 files per transfer. There is no total-storage account at all. It is a per-transfer envelope.
record.binding_note: a clock, not a quota: bytes leave whether or not transfer is completed
